requirement.subjectNotes: Three programme-relevant HL subjects require at least grade 5 under the Health and Allied Sciences exception. English/Literature and Mathematics at SL require at least grade 4. Specific HL subject names are not supplied; no total is derived from these grades.
requirement.conditions: Four-year regular route, not the separate sandwich programme. A written test and interview are required. No entry year, intake date or IB total is stated. Department and school pages disagree on whether applications are open; confirm the current window. International eligibility is not established by this local-applicant section.
